invariants.rationale: The method returns a List created via collect(Collectors.toList()), which never returns null.
Each fileId in the result is produced by getFileId(), which is assumed to return non-null values for valid file slices.
The result is explicitly collected after a distinct() call, so all entries must be unique.
If partitionPath is null, getLatestFileSlices likely returns an empty stream, leading to an empty result.
No null fileIds should be present in the result list.
